claim: 15 U.S.C. 4651(2) defines a CHIPS 'covered entity' as a nonprofit or private entity or consortium able to substantially finance, build, expand or modernize a facility for fabrication, assembly, testing, advanced packaging, production or R&D of semiconductors, materials used to make semiconductors, or semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
evidence: "(2) The term 'covered entity' means a nonprofit entity, a private entity, a consortium of private entities, or a consortium of nonprofit, public, and private entities with a demonstrated ability to substantially finance, construct, expand, or modernize a facility relating to fabrication, assembly, testing, advanced packaging, production, or research and development of semiconductors, materials used to manufacture semiconductors, or semiconductor manufacturing equipment." (15 U.S.C. 4651(2))
notes: Corrected version of CLM-0024 without the interpretive 'so U.S. policy treats...' clause.

claim: The U.S. ITA said ranking export markets for semiconductors was difficult because overseas packaging, final assembly and transshipments skew semiconductor import and export data, so it used WSTS regional market data instead.
evidence: "It was difficult in the case of semiconductors, however, due to overseas packaging and final assembly of semiconductors and transshipments skewing the import and export data." ... "This has improved the methodology for semiconductors, as the WSTS data is used in this year's calculation." (ITA 2016 Top Markets Report, Executive Summary, Methodology)

claim: TrendForce estimated combined revenue of the world's top ten foundries (including Samsung Foundry, excluding System LSI) at nearly US$46.3 billion in 4Q25, with TSMC holding a 70.4% share.
evidence: "pushed the combined revenue of the world's top ten foundries up 2.6% QoQ to nearly US$46.3 billion in 4Q25"; TSMC "$33.7 billion, which allowed TSMC to maintain its leading position with a 70.4% market share" (TrendForce, 12 Mar 2026)

metric.methodology: TrendForce estimate; method not disclosed in public release
metric.name: Top-10 foundry revenue
metric.population: Top 10 foundry-service providers; Samsung Foundry excluding System LSI

notes: Corrects 'pure foundry-service providers' in CLM-0068: the ranking includes Samsung Foundry, a division of an IDM.
